description: Given a goal in plain words - "keep the checkout flow green" - says what Tewip would do next and why, from what it can actually see in the project. The order is fixed and published: a real bug first, then the environment, then flakiness, then anything failing it cannot explain, then a coverage gap. It decides only; it never changes a file.

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

name: next_action
title: What should be done next about a goal?
